articles.title: Indian Navy commissions helicopter squadron INAS 335 'Ospreys' in Goa
articles.summary: The Indian Navy commissioned INAS 335 'Ospreys', its second squadron of advanced MH-60R 'Romeo' anti-submarine helicopters, at INS Hansa, Panaji. The Chief of Naval Staff was present. This strategic induction significantly bolsters India's anti-submarine warfare (ASW) capabilities and maritime security, enhancing operational readiness in the Indian Ocean Region.

articles.title: Putin: Dialogue with Europe 'unlikely'
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin, during an address at the Russian Defence Ministry Board Meeting, conveyed deep pessimism regarding the prospects for dialogue between Russia and European nations. His statements underscore the ongoing deterioration of diplomatic relations, signaling a hardened stance from Moscow amidst current geopolitical tensions. This outlook suggests continued challenges for de-escalation and engagement between Russia and the West, which is crucial for SSB aspirants to understand in geopolitical analysis.

articles.title: ‘Ukraine’s most successful battlefield’: Black Sea wins keep Odesa port open for business
articles.summary: Odesa experienced a four-day power outage this week following a massive Russian missile and drone strike. The attack severely crippled energy infrastructure in and around the Ukrainian Black Sea port city. This incident highlights Russia's ongoing strategy of targeting critical civilian infrastructure in the conflict, significantly impacting essential services and daily life for residents amidst the protracted war.

articles.title: Links 12/17/2025
articles.summary: Scientist Bruce Damer, as reported in Nautilus, explored the origins of life on Earth, reportedly gaining profound insights while under the influence of ayahuasca. His unconventional method for scientific inquiry, though involving psychedelics, aims to understand fundamental biological processes and offers a unique perspective on how life might have begun on our planet. This research challenges traditional scientific exploration.
